fusions.name: Sinks Through Plate
fusions.desc: A red-hot point that deals 4 fire damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Each hit has a 40% chance to leave it [Burning] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Catching Sparks
fusions.desc: Flicks 3 sparks off a heated point, spread apart, each dealing 8 fire damage and leaving its target [Burning] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Sterilised in Flame
fusions.desc: Removes 2 conditions from you and restores 10 health.

fusions.name: Flying Ember
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, a spark leaps to the nearest other enemy within 5 tiles for 6 lightning damage and sets it [Burning] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. Once every 5 seconds.
